"Finance available" is not a finance page.

A buyer who reads that line in your footer still has three questions:
• What would I pay a month?
• What's the rate, for how long, and what do I repay in total?
• Can I even get it, and what do I need to apply?

Give financing its own page that answers all three:
→ A monthly cost tool with a choice of terms
→ Rate, term and total repaid in plain words, with a worked example and the lender's name
→ What you need to apply and how long it takes
→ Link it right next to your price, one tap away
